stem: What is the most effective revision to make in sentence 16?

options.label: A
options.text: Everyone communicates in person in one way, they communicate in different ways over the phone, through texting, or in online posts.

options.label: B
options.text: Everyone communicates differently in person than they do when speaking over the phone, sending texts, or writing online posts.

options.label: C
options.text: Everyone communicates in person differently than they do over the phone, to send texts, or posting online.

options.label: D
options.text: Everyone communicates in person, over the phone, through texting, or in online posts differently.
